terms.plain: A YouTube video that sorts products into ranked groups (tiers), such as boardzy's lists. On this site, 'tier' only means a reviewer's own tier list; our own ranking uses ladder groups instead. boardzy says he recommends anything in A tier or above. In boardzy's lists the top group is his "based" tier (the auto-captions often spell it "base tier"). He says A tier and based tier are "more or less the same" and calls both "the top quality options"; the based tier holds his personal favourites, such as ARTISAN pads. His skate list uses the same scale: he says one skate "could be a tier or base" and that "base tiered is based for a reason".
